rounds.text: Aditya Consumer Marketing Ltd trades at a modest market capitalisation of ₹ 47.6 Cr [E2] with a price-to-book ratio of just 2.56x on a book value of ₹ 12.7 [E1]. The business is actively pivoting toward profitability, evidenced by a quarterly operating margin of 1% in March 2026 which represents a sharp four percentage point recovery from negative four percent in the year-ago quarter [E20]. Furthermore, fundamental screening confirms positive operational momentum through year-over-year profit growth exceeding twenty percent alongside sequential sales increases quarter-on-quarter [E52, E54]. Conceded: the stock rests near the bottom of its 52-week range at just nine percent from its low [E4], and trailing annual sales growth remains negative at minus six percent [E10]. Nevertheless, this severe contraction in past metrics is already heavily priced in, masking the nascent operational turnaround visible in the latest quarterly margin expansion [E20].
